title: WO writer visual review requires actual hashed desktop and mobile kit image delivery
steps: Open real image files from a hashed kit zip using the writer image tool and send them through the shared model wire into an answered writing turn.
Exercise unanswered requests, another run, forged references, missing mobile captures and missing catalogue hashes; compare historical input.
expect: Both responsive image payloads reach the model and WV01 passes only with answered matching evidence.
Incomplete or foreign evidence fails visual review; historical writer input remains text-only.
fence: frozen writer visual policy and actual image references verified against the kit catalogue and answered run history

tests: writer opens hashed desktop and mobile kit files and delivers their actual pixels to an answered writing turn
writer refuses unviewed, unanswered, forged and other-run image evidence
writer image requirements reject missing mobile captures and hashes while historical requests keep their original input
a strict writer queue freezes image policy and passes only after answered responsive image delivery
a strict writer queue keeps blocking visual failures for valid copy without actual image delivery
